papers.title: 2-Step Agent: How a Bayesian Decision Maker Learns from AI-Decision Support
papers.reason: Presents a Bayesian computational model of how a human decision maker updates beliefs from AI decision support, but its focus is general assisted decision making rather than planning, working memory, attention, or cognitive control specifically.

papers.title: Quantitative Analysis of Electroencephalography in Hypnosis: A Neurophysiological Approach.
papers.reason: The title indicates quantitative EEG analysis of hypnosis, which may relate indirectly to attention or cognitive control but is not clearly centered on executive function modelling or assessment.

papers.title: Resting-state fMRI biomarkers of surgical outcome in temporal lobe epilepsy: Network reorganization, rsfMRI-based prediction models, and cognition - A systematic review.
papers.reason: This is a clinical neuroimaging biomarker review involving cognition, but it is not specifically about executive function, task-based behavioural assessment, EEG, eye tracking, or computational modelling.

papers.title: Altered network organization with shift to local processing during adaptive behavior in multiple sclerosis
papers.reason: Directly studies EEG theta connectivity and behavioural switch costs during task switching in healthy controls and multiple sclerosis patients, providing strong neural and behavioural findings on cognitive control.
